scientific_integrity: Definitions, both configuration types, enumeration and all-pairs exchange arguments are explicit in the proof. Standalone check programs independently verify the forest equivalence exhaustively through order six and exchange metric through order nine. Same-model review only; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the full one-edge subdivision of labeled complete graphs, with the usual power-domination initial closed-neighborhood step and unrestricted one-location exchange; the all-order proof is not an external certification. The 2002 journal issue precedes the earliest directly verifiable exact electronic publication day of the archival motivation source (2006-08-01). Forest counts and generic zero-forcing properties are acknowledged as prior work. No novelty guarantee against unindexed literature.
title: Nonmatroidal isometric power-domination exchanges in fully subdivided cliques
